name: Swapos V2
fix_description: In swap, the K-value invariant check uses mismatched scaling: left side uses mul(10000) but right side uses mul(1000**2). The fee was changed from 0.3% to 0.1% by adjusting the left side scaling to 10000, but the right side constant was not updated from 1000**2 to 10000**2. This weakens the K check by 100x, allowing swaps that violate the invariant. Fix: change require to balance0Adjusted.mul(balance1Adjusted) >= _reserve0.mul(_reserve1).mul(10000**2).
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a single-pool, essentially one-step exploit with only a tiny setup and one critical swap call after transferring dust WETH. It does not require flash loans, multi-contract coordination, or deep protocol-specific reasoning beyond recognizing a straightforward swap/reserve imbalance issue.
